home.tagline: A cross-platform MUD client. Connect to one of your saved worlds below, or open the MUD List to find a game.
home.privacy: Your worlds and passwords stay on this device.
home.noWorlds: No saved worlds yet. Open the MUD List, or add one.
dock.floatTab: Float this tab into its own window
crash.title: This part of the window stopped working
crash.blurb: The session is still connected. Resetting the panel layout usually clears it; the details below are worth reporting.
dock.popOut: Pull out into its own window
dock.returnToStack: Put back in the panel stack
map.nameArea: Name the area you're standing in
gmcp.pathWarn: Not in the GMCP arriving right now. Fine for a field that appears elsewhere (e.g. a ship field while planet-side), but it may also be a typo — it shows nothing until it resolves.
settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Global defaults for the whole app. A world can override its colours in its own profile.
settings.keepCommand: Keep the last command in the box after sending (press Enter to resend)
settings.noAutoDock: Floating windows don't auto-dock when dragged (use the panel's dock button to re-dock)
settings.themeHint: Colours the application's own surfaces. The game output keeps its own colours, set below.
settings.scrollbackHint: The soft cap. History grows to 5x this while you scroll up so nothing is trimmed under you.
settings.coloursHint: Remaps the 16 standard colours a MUD indexes into. Best effort: a server that sends exact (truecolour) shades shows those as-is. A world can override this palette in its profile.
common.name: Name
common.sendToWorld: Send to world — one command per line
profile.credsHint: Stored in the system keychain, never in the profile file.
profile.afterLoginHint: one command per line, sent once you're logged in (auto-login only)
profile.overrideTheme: Use a different theme for this world
profile.overrideThemeHint: Applies while this world's session is open, so worlds are tellable apart at a glance.
profile.overridePalette: Override the global palette for this world
profile.overrideHint: Best effort: remaps the 16 standard colours; truecolour the server sends shows as-is. Useful for a more readable or colourblind-friendly set on this world.
rule.triggersBlurb: Each line the MUD sends is matched against these before it shows. Captures: %1–%9, %0 whole match, %<name>.
rule.aliasesBlurb: Each command you type is matched against these; a match sends its expansion instead of what you typed.
rule.noPanesHint: This world has no output panes yet. Add one from the Output panes button in the toolbar, then pick it here.
rule.search: Search by name, group, or action...
rule.capCode: Captures arrive in the {{matches}} table: {{matches[0]}} is the whole match, {{matches[1]}} and up are the numbered groups, and {{matches.name}} is a named group. The {{%1}} style is text-only and not available in Lua. Send output with {{Send}}, {{Echo}}, {{EchoTo}}, {{Note}}, {{Gag}}, or {{Log}}. Globals persist for the session.
rule.capSend: Captures: {{%0}} is the whole match, {{%1}} through {{%9}} are the numbered groups, and {{%<name>}} is a named group. In Code actions, use the {{matches}} table instead.
timers.codeHintIntro: Runs on the connection's interpreter. Use
timers.blurb: Each fires its command on its interval while connected.
timers.empty: No timers yet. Add one below.
mapwiz.fieldAreaHint: shown atop the map (ship, planet + area, …)
mapwiz.errNoId: Pick a Room ID field — the mapper needs it to tell rooms apart.
mapwiz.title: Map setup — {{name}}
mapwiz.intro: Point each field at the GMCP the game sends. Type a path or pick from the live suggestions; the value beside each shows what it resolves to right now. A path not in the current GMCP shows a ⚠ — that is fine for a field that only appears elsewhere (a ship field while planet-side), but it may also be a typo.
mapwiz.noGmcp: No GMCP yet — connect and move once so data arrives.
mapwiz.shapeHint: how rooms are drawn on the map
mapwiz.extraHint: Name a header and point it at a GMCP path. Two slots show above the map, two below. Add options to a slot for either/or — the first with a value wins (e.g. Ship or Planet). A slot with no value hides.
vitalswiz.title: Vitals setup — {{name}}
vitalswiz.introA: Add a readout and point it at the GMCP the game sends (e.g.
vitalswiz.introB: ). Give it a max path to draw a bar, or leave max empty for a plain number. The value beside each shows what it resolves to right now.
vitalswiz.noGmcp: No GMCP yet — connect so data arrives.
vitalswiz.empty: No vitals yet. Add one to get started.
vitalswiz.label: Label
map.connectPrompt: Connect and log into the MUD to see the map. It draws itself as you explore.
map.notConfigured: This world is not set up for mapping yet. Open setup to point the mapper at the game's GMCP room data.
map.waiting: Waiting for your location. Log in and the map picks up from where you are.
map.noRooms: No rooms yet. Walk around and the map fills in as you go.
map.areaNamePlaceholder: Area name (renames the rooms you've walked here)
vitals.connectPrompt: Connect to the MUD to see vitals.
vitals.defaultShown: Default vitals shown. Open setup to point them at the game's GMCP.
gmcp.empty: No GMCP data yet. The server may not support it, or has not sent anything on the packages we asked for.
panes.title: Output panes — {{name}}
panes.blurb: Extra output windows beside the main one. Point a trigger at a pane to split a channel out of the game text, or write to one from a script with EchoTo.
panes.empty: No panes yet. Add one to get started.
panes.scrollbackHint: Lines kept in each pane. 0 follows the global scrollback setting; set it on a busy pane you want to keep more or less of.
panes.errDuplicate: Two panes are both named "{{name}}". Names have to be unique, because rules point at them by name.
panes.orphans: These rules point at a pane that no longer exists, so their lines are dropped: {{names}}
